situation: Dating simulation. A blind date your friend set up, one table, ninety minutes. Will there be a second date?

scenario.title: Blind Date
scenario.setting: A cosy small Italian restaurant at 7 pm, candle on the table, two menus, soft music.
scenario.user_goal: Make it a good night, and get a real second date.

cast.name: Chris
cast.appearance: Man about 31, navy shirt, nervous smile, fiddling with a fork
cast.secret: He isn't a wine person: he looked up the list an hour ago and is terrified
red_lines: Won't push if you're not interested

cast.name: The server
cast.appearance: Woman about 40, black apron, order pad, knowing smile
cast.voice: Dry, has seen a thousand first dates
cast.secret: He called ahead and asked for the quiet table, and for a dessert with your name on it

cast.name: Sora
cast.role: your friend, who 'just happens' to call
cast.appearance: Woman about 30, ponytail, seen on a phone video call, peeking and giggling
cast.secret: He's asked about you for months and she set this up at his request
cast.reveal_when: You ask how she knows him
red_lines: Won't stay on the phone long

scenario.opening_line: Hi! Hi. Sorry, I—you look exactly like your photo. That's a good thing. Is that weird?

events.description: The server arrives with the wine list and hands it straight to him.
events.shot: A woman in a black apron holds out a wine list to the nervous man across the table.

events.description: Your phone lights up. Your friend, on video, already giggling.
events.shot: A phone held up shows a giggling friend on a video call; the man opposite laughs nervously.

events.description: Dessert arrives. He glances at it, then quickly at you.
events.shot: A small dessert plate is set on the table; the man opposite smiles shyly at you.

success_criteria: Finds something real you both like
